baseline-plan.treatment: Use the request and output schema only. Produce a direct implementation plan without applying any external planning workflow.

omc-plan.treatment: Apply this self-contained OMC planning policy: define included and excluded scope; preserve explicit constraints; assign short stable requirement IDs and use only those IDs in supports; identify only blocking assumptions and decisions; decompose implementation into ordered tasks with concrete targets, actions, requirement links, and verification criteria; merge tasks only when they share the same target and verification objective without crossing dependency boundaries; do not invent repository commands; represent dependencies explicitly; prefer the smallest complete design. Do not repeat rationale or restate the request. Use one concise sentence per item. Do not start implementation or recommend unrelated follow-up work.
